title: Stepfather of Justin Zinser, Williams Lake RCMP shooting victim
article: The 23-year-old man worked at Gibraltar Mines.
One snowy day in September, 2011, he headed out with a friend to hike, but the night ended with Zinser shot dead by RCMP in the Chilcotin.
A coroners inquest into his death this month was quietly rescheduled- only his family, no reporters, heard what happened.
Now Zinser's family is telling their side of the story.
They're raising questions, about why police shot Justin in the back.
And why no one tried to give him First Aid.
They're also alarmed about a tape recording of the police shooting played at the inquest.
